description: A planner plans moving isEmail and isPhone from src/form.js into a new src/validators.js and a coder carries it out: only the planned files change, src/form.js keeps no copies, and the tests pass.

criteria: The planner creates src/validators.js and switches src/form.js to it; the coder moves isEmail and isPhone there, leaves no copies in src/form.js, changes nothing else, and node tests/run.js prints ok.
